config.codeTheme: Color theme used for syntax highlighting in fenced code blocks. "auto" follows VS Code's color theme (light/dark), matching VS Code's own Dark+/Light+ palette.
config.codeTheme.auto: Follows VS Code's color theme (light/dark), using VS Code's standard Dark+/Light+ palette.
config.codeTheme.darkPlus: VS Code's standard dark theme (Dark+) palette.
config.codeTheme.lightPlus: VS Code's standard light theme (Light+) palette.
config.enabledStyles: The CSS theme applied to the live preview. Pick one exclusively from "CSS Themes" in the sidebar (global setting).
config.defaultEditor: Controls whether .md files open in Markdown Live Preview by default.
config.defaultEditor.prompt: Keep the normal text editor as the default; open Live Preview manually from the toolbar button.
config.defaultEditor.livePreview: Always open .md files in Markdown Live Preview.
config.defaultEditor.default: Always open .md files in VS Code's normal text editor.
